description: You are an epidemiologist conducting a comprehensive food safety investigation of an E. coli O157:H7 outbreak. The EColi dataset (C:\EpiInfo7\Projects\EColi\EColi.mdb) contains interview data from individuals who attended a picnic where the outbreak occurred. Your tasks are: (1) Read the FoodHistory table into Classic Analysis. (2) Explore all variables — identify all food exposure variables (hamburger, hotdog, watermelon, etc.), the illness outcome variable, onset date, and demographic variables. (3) Run FREQ on all food exposure variables and the outcome. (4) For each food item, run a TABLES analysis against the illness outcome to compute crude odds ratios — this is the attack rate table. (5) Identify which food items are statistically significant risk factors (p<0.05). (6) Run a multivariable LOGISTIC regression with illness as the outcome and all significant food items as predictors to identify independent risk factors while controlling for confounding. (7) Run a time analysis: use the GRAPH or FREQ command to examine onset dates (epidemic curve data). (8) Save ALL output to C:\Users\Docker\ecoli_food_investigation.html using ROUTEOUT REPLACE. (9) Write a summary risk factor table to C:\Users\Docker\ecoli_risk_factors.csv. This represents a full outbreak investigation report-quality analysis.
